answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk forgery. To claim one slot, an agent burns a 20 POA deposit and docks at the network jetty. An honest agent earns it back from one slot's fees, so one real identity costs nearly nothing net. A forger minting 1,000 fakes must burn 20,000 POA, and the delta between sunk cost and slot reward stays negative. An oasis waters only paying travelers: the network burns the deposit of any agent caught idle or duplicated.
